purpose: Independently confirm on completely fresh unseen material whether the frozen PSSB intervention reproduces the I4K-5R3 surface-effect signal when generation and evaluation are separated and the quality judges have no access to arm identity, R3 scores, or R3 result.
research_question: With a fresh episode and byte-identical shared upstream semantics, does the frozen R3 PSSB treatment outperform the frozen no-PSSB control under independent masked judges while preserving upper narrative architecture, continuity, and hygiene?
hypothesis: Independent masked judges will reproduce the R3 direction of effect: Treatment will meet the unchanged H1 pairwise threshold and at least +0.30 mean gains on dialogue/subtext naturalness, stage-direction playability, and broadcast-readiness specificity, without protected-axis loss or critical hygiene/continuity violations.

frozen_intervention.control: Frozen R2-repaired surface renderer baseline with legitimate detailed situation direction and dialogue repair, but without PSSB.
frozen_intervention.treatment: Same byte-identical shared upstream plus the frozen R3 PSSB intervention only.
frozen_intervention.PSSB: Bind already-licensed important scene turns to actor-visible or camera-legible consequence through naturally available action, prop use, blocking, timing, interruption, silence, failed action, bodily effort or spatial change; avoid abstract explanatory tails when action already carries the consequence; compress procedural exposition where facts can be distributed through action-response; preserve character-specific rhythm and already-licensed causal location/prop use.
forbidden_changes: new backstory added solely for surface decoration

generation_scale.attempt_rule: Only scale/structure/hygiene/shared-semantics admission failures detected before masking and before quality evaluation may trigger the second provisional attempt. First prescore-admitted attempt is final. No post-score retry.

generation_evaluation_separation.generation_agent_may_perform: upstream design, arm rendering, deterministic mechanics, semantic/continuity admission, blind packet construction
generation_evaluation_separation.generation_agent_must_not_perform: authoritative R4 quality score used for independent confirmation
generation_evaluation_separation.quality_evaluation: three fresh independent judge invocations/sessions with no generation conversation context, no mapping, no R3 score/result, and no other judge score
generation_evaluation_separation.mapping: separate sealed mapping artifact; unavailable to judges; opened only after all three judge score packets are individually sealed

masked_sample.U12: whole-episode broadcast surface/craft after full read
masked_sample.length_hint_control: A/B bytes equalized within each unit without altering visible prose

independent_confirmation_rule.judge_individual_pass: Each judge is evaluated against unchanged H1, H2 and H3; objective H4 must already pass before judging.
independent_confirmation_rule.cross_judge_surface_rule: For each of the three H2 surface axes, the median of the three judge-level Treatment-Control deltas must be >= +0.30.
independent_confirmation_rule.cross_judge_structure_rule: For every H3 protected axis, the median of the three judge-level deltas must be >= -0.10 and adoption must remain NONLOSS.
independent_confirmation_rule.critical_rule: Any verified critical continuity, hygiene or source/mapping leakage invalidates or fails the affected execution according to prespecified cause; it cannot be repaired after score inspection.
independent_confirmation_rule.PASS: At least 2/3 independent judges pass H1-H3, all cross-judge median H2/H3 rules pass, and H4 remains PASS => PASS__INDEPENDENT_JUDGE_CONFIRMATION__FRESH_HUMAN_VALIDATION_AUTHORIZED.
independent_confirmation_rule.FAIL: A valid scored execution that does not meet the confirmation rule => FAIL__INDEPENDENT_CONFIRMATION_NOT_REPRODUCED; preserve result and repair-forward only in a new preregistered experiment.
independent_confirmation_rule.HOLD: Provider/receipt/masking/prescore integrity failure before valid scoring => HOLD; do not infer quality result.

execution_order: render Control then Treatment under frozen arms
build leak-resistant A/B mask and separate mapping
obtain and seal three independent judge packets separately
open mapping only after all three judge packets are sealed
compute judge-level and cross-judge H1-H4 confirmation result
if PASS authorize but do not perform fresh-human validation without its own sealed protocol
promotion_boundary: Even R4 independent-judge PASS does not promote Active Engine, Production, DB, Formal count or R140. It authorizes a separately governed fresh-human validation step only.
